records.title: Water
records.statementTitle: 2016 ACM ICPC Southeast USA Regional Division 1, Problem J — Water
records.observed: A water utility network has bidirectional pipes with capacities. Across a sequence of permanent improvements, it increases existing pipe capacities or installs new pipes. After every improvement, report the maximum water flow from pumping station to mansion.
records.inputOutput: Input: stations, initial pipes and a sequence of capacity increases/new pipes. Output: maximum flow after initial setup and after every improvement.
records.constraints: 2 ≤ n ≤ 100; p ≤ n(n−1)/2; 1 ≤ k ≤ 10,000; pipe capacities and increments ≤ 1,000.
records.scenarioAssessment: Strong contextual candidate: real utility-network setting, evolving network state, repeated operational queries, capacity constraints and max-flow objective. Needs final rubric consistency review; not approved for import.

records.title: Fire
records.observed: A person is trapped in a building with spreading fires and walls. Fire advances every second; the person must reach an exit without entering a cell that is burning or about to burn, with simultaneous escape allowed.
records.inputOutput: Input: multiple building maps containing rooms, walls, one person and fire sources. Output: minimum escape time or IMPOSSIBLE.
records.constraints: At most 100 test cases; width and height each from 1 to 1,000.
records.scenarioAssessment: Clear emergency-response context and interacting time-dependent hazards, but a single time-dependent BFS escape problem. Moderate scenario candidate; not automatically long-scenario approved.

records.title: Train Sorting
records.observed: Erin arranges arriving train cars by adding each new car to the beginning or end of a train, or rejecting it. The resulting train must be ordered by weight and as long as possible.
records.inputOutput: Input: number of cars followed by distinct car weights. Output: maximum possible train length.
records.constraints: 0 ≤ n ≤ 2,000; weights are nonnegative and distinct.
records.scenarioAssessment: Waterloo 2008 Spring A source family corroborated by an independent judge mirror; exact submitted June 15 date remains unverified. Short train-car story and single LIS-style objective; not a long-scenario candidate.
